6843.d: Corbicula rex is a tier 2 Big Game Hunter creature requiring level 90 Hunter and level 70 Slayer to catch.
6843.ex: Spiky on the outside, soft in the middle.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: The fastest way to get to the Corbicula rex hunting spot is casting Eastern Anachronia Teleport and running clockwise around the top edge of the hunter area. Alternatively, the spot can be reached by running from the Anachronia lodestone while utilising parts of the agility course. Other methods include teleporting to Laniakea using Slayer cape, casting Anachronia Teleport with nearby totem slot filled with the Totem of the Abyss, or teleporting to the Moksha ritual site or Xolo city via an Orthen teleportation device.

6865.d: The Corporeal Beast is the physical incarnation of the Spirit Beast, and is a boss monster.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Corporeal Beast can be found at the end of a series of three large chambers. The entrance to the caverns is located in level 33 Wilderness, not far from the Graveyard of Shadows. The cavern can only be entered if the Gielinor version of the entrance is not collapsed; otherwise, players must head into the Spirit Realm and collapse that version before the Gielinor version is open again.

However, players who have completed Summer's End may use a games necklace to teleport directly into the first of the caverns, or use the Boss portal to bring them right outside the chamber it resides in. Attempting to leave the caverns back out into the Wilderness while opted into PvP will cause a Wilderness warning prompt to appear before the player can continue.

Though the caves' entrance is in the Wilderness, the caverns themselves and the Corporeal Beast's lair are not dangerous Wilderness territory, as PVP and Wilderness level are disabled here. Before entering its room, players may investigate the passage and select the "Peek in" option to see a zoomed-in view of the Corporeal Beast's spawn point, in order to determine whether any other players are currently fighting it in an uninstanced encounter.

6869.d: The Corporeal Beast's Lair is the lair of the Corporeal Beast.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Via Gielinor surface
• By far the fastest way to reach the Corporeal Beast's Lair is teleporting directly to the boss via games necklace, boss portal (Max Guild) or boss portal (War's Retreat).
• The enlightened amulet or Carrallangar Teleport can be used to teleport to the Graveyard of Shadows, then walking north to the main entrance of the lair.
• Similarly any means of accessing the Wilderness Obelisk (obelisk shard, portable obelisk or manually) to teleport to the level 35 obelisk and running east or level 18 obelisk and running north.

Via Spirit Realm

Head to the eastern ruins in level 28 Wilderness and operate Jennica's ring on the weak portal to the Spirit Realm. Then go north to the entrance.
